title: Fair Bubble Sort: Provably Optimal Fair Ranking with Continuous Sensitive Attributes
abstract: arXiv:2611.22352v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Most fair-ranking methods assume categorical protected attributes, requiring continuous attributes such as age or income to be discretized into groups. This introduces arbitrary thresholds, loses fine-grained information, and ignores the natural ordering of the attribute. In this paper, we study the problem of fair ranking with continuous protected attributes without relying on thresholding. We introduce Continuous Pairwise Parity (CPP), a fairness notion based on Kendall correlation between ranking positions and the protected attribute, and seek rankings that satisfy a prescribed CPP constraint while minimizing their Kemeny distance from an initial score-based ranking. To solve this problem, we propose Fair Bubble Sort (FBS), an efficient post-processing algorithm based on targeted adjacent swaps. We prove that FBS is exactly optimal for the unweighted Kemeny distance and provide approximation guarantees for the score-weighted setting.

translated_title: 公平冒泡排序：针对连续敏感属性的可证明最优公平排序
translated_abstract: 大多数公平排序方法都假设受保护属性是类别型的，需要将年龄或收入等连续属性离散化成若干组。这会引入任意的阈值，丢失细粒度信息，并忽略属性本身固有的顺序。在本文中，我们研究了不依赖阈值化的、面向连续受保护属性的公平排序问题。我们提出了连续成对公平性，这是一种基于排序位置与受保护属性之间Kendall相关性的公平性概念，并寻求在满足给定CPP约束的同时、与初始基于分数的排序之间Kemeny距离最小的排序。为解决这一问题，我们提出了公平冒泡排序（FBS），一种基于有针对性相邻交换的高效后处理算法。我们证明FBS在无权重Kemeny距离下是精确最优的，并为分数加权情形提供了近似保证。
tldr: 本文提出连续成对公平性（CPP）这一新公平性概念，并设计了基于针对性相邻交换的公平冒泡排序（FBS）后处理算法，首次实现无需离散化处理的连续敏感属性公平排序，且证明了该算法在无权重Kemeny距离下精确最优。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Continuous Pairwise Parity (CPP) and an efficient Fair Bubble Sort (FBS) post-processing algorithm, enabling fair ranking with continuous sensitive attributes without discretization, and proves FBS is exactly optimal for unweighted Kemeny distance.
